judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names and type names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `sessions`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of those specified in the ticket (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `conversations`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`). It completely omitted the opt-in `HalEngineConfig.transport.history` configuration, the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` code, and `StoreCannotList`. Furthermore, when a store does not implement `listFor`, the candidate returns an empty array `sessions: []`, which directly violates the explicit requirement and acceptance criterion to return an `UNSUPPORTED` error and have no code path sending an empty list. In validation, it also accepts `limit: 0` and `limit > 200`, whereas the ticket requires `limit` to be an integer between 1 and 200, and it failed to update `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`.
